_README: Integration tests that CANNOT run against the fake, with the reason.
Every entry here is a claim that the offline tier is structurally unable
to answer the question the test asks -- not that the test is failing and
we would rather not look. Two causes appear below and both are honest:
recording_gap  The fake serves ONE recorded response per endpoint. A
test that varies a parameter and asserts the response
changes needs two recordings; the conformance corpus has
one. Fixable by recording the variant (see
tests/conformance/README.md), not by faking the logic --
a fake that computed the answer would be asserting on
bad_fixture    The recorded snapshot is a captured ERROR response, so
there is no valid payload to serve. A defect in the
missing_route  The test calls an endpoint that is not in the catalog at
all, and the fake has nothing to serve.

calls /search_functions_by_name, which is not among the 253 endpoints in tests/endpoints.json. The catalogued endpoint is /search_functions (params: name_pattern, offset, limit, program). See expected_contract_violations.json.
